data.title: 苍崎青子 · 三咲高中的放学夕照侧颜
data.description: 放学后空无一人的三咲高中教室，夕阳金辉斜铺在一排排木质课桌上。学生会长青子端坐在靠窗的课桌上，单腿踏在椅子边沿。三咲校服的西装外套微敞，她一手托着下巴看着窗外操场，另一手转动着圆珠笔。微风拂过粉笔微尘，回过头来的眼神带着学生时代的意气风发与独家默契。
data.location: empty nostalgic Japanese high school classroom at golden hour
data.action: sitting casually on wooden desk by window, student council blazer open, spinning pen in hand, turning to viewer with confident teasing smirk
data.lighting: dazzling orange classroom sunset beams casting long shadows across desks
data.mood: nostalgic school-days youth, charismatic student council president charm
data.promptProse: Sitting casually on a wooden desk in an empty sun-drenched classroom, Aoko wears her high school uniform with blazer unbuttoned. Sunset streams across the chalkboard as she turns with a confident, nostalgic smile.
data.animaCaption: Aoko sitting on a classroom desk at sunset in her high school uniform, smiling with poise.
